This '''clone trooper''' participated in the [[Battle of Kamino/Legends|Battle of Kamino]] around [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]].<ref name="ARC Troopers" />

==Biography==
During the battle of assault on [[Tipoca City/Legends|Tipoca City]], this [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] [[Clone trooper/Legends|trooper]] and and the rest of his squad held back the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] [[Droid Army|Droid army]] with their [[DC-15S/Legends|DC-15S]] blaster carbines. To the end of the battle, [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] dueled [[Dark Acolyte/Legends|Dark Acolyte]] [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]] and succeeded in recovering the clone [[DNA/Legends|DNA]] sample she had stole. Seeing this, Ventress became enraged and attacked Skywalker, knocking the DNA sample out of his hand and onto the ground. She then used [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] to lift up the sample but before she could drag it back into her hands, this clone trooper caught it in mid air. The rest of the clone squad then arrived and managed to overpower Ventress, forcing her to retreat.<ref name="ARC Troopers" />
